pages.text: Cauldron Crafting is a crafting system used to make many different Stellarity items, mostly Foods and Potions.
Fill a Cauldron with Water and throw 1 Dragon's Breath into the Cauldron, you can useup to 7 items before needing to throw another Dragon's Breath.

Most potions can be upgraded through Cauldron Crafting. To upgrade a potion, throw in an eligible potion alongside a piece of Glowstone Dust. The only exception to this is Royal Jelly, which uses Starlight Soot.
All potions ending with ''Potion'', with the exception of Red Potion, can be extended through Cauldron Crafting. To extend a potion, throw in an eligible potion alongside a piece of Redstone Dust.
